<thought>Based on the observed mass (m/z ≈ 121 [M+H]⁺) the neutral formula is C₈H₈O. The ¹H NMR shows only the five aromatic protons of a monosubstituted benzene, indicating the substituent carries no hydrogens. The ¹³C NMR displays a carbonyl carbon around 168 ppm and six aromatic carbons, consistent with an aldehyde attached to the ring via a CH₂ group (phenylacetaldehyde). The SMILES that matches the formula C₈H₈O and the spectral data is “O=CCc1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=CCc1ccccc1</final_answer>
